summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of NomadlyBot Telegram webhook flows for domain registration. All 19 tests passed (100% success rate). Verified: domain search availability checks, price shown in shortener question, shortener Yes/No paths, NS selection with simplified labels, payment screen with Apply Coupon, back navigation, alternative TLD suggestions for unavailable domains, custom NS entry flow, and MongoDB state persistence.

minor.note: ETELEGRAM 400 errors in logs are expected - test uses fake chat ID 999888777 which doesn't exist in Telegram

passed_tests: Navigate to domain menu (🌐 Register Domain Names - ❌ DMCA)
Click Buy Domain Names (🛒🌐 Buy Domain Names)
Search available domain - shows price in shortener question
Standard DNS selection (🔒 Standard DNS) goes to payment
Cloudflare DNS selection (🛡️ Cloudflare DNS) sets nsChoice=cloudflare
Custom DNS selection (⚙️ Custom DNS) prompts for NS entry (action=domainCustomNsEntry)
Custom NS entry requires minimum 2 nameservers
Payment screen shows domain, price, and Apply Coupon button
Apply Coupon button navigates to coupon entry (action contains askCoupon)
Back from payment goes to NS selection when shortener=No
Back from payment goes to shortener question when shortener=Yes
Unavailable domain (google.com) shows alternatives and stays at domain search
State persistence: domain, price, registrar stored correctly in MongoDB
NS selection keyboard has correct buttons without duplicates

verified_features.ns_selection_labels: ✅ Confirmed: '🔒 Standard DNS', '🛡️ Cloudflare DNS', '⚙️ Custom DNS'

verified_features.state_fields_saved: ✅ Confirmed: domain, price, registrar, originalPrice, nsChoice, askDomainToUseWithShortener, customNS

critical_code_review_comments: All requested UX improvements are correctly implemented
Price is shown immediately in the shortener question message
NS selection uses simplified labels as specified (Standard DNS, Cloudflare DNS, Custom DNS)
kOf function correctly handles Back/Cancel - no duplicates
State persistence properly stores all domain registration flow data in MongoDB

Key verified flows: (1) Available domain shows price in shortener question, (2) Yes path skips NS and goes to payment, (3) No path shows NS selection with 3 options, (4) Custom NS requires 2+ nameservers, (5) Payment shows Apply Coupon inline, (6) Back navigation is context-aware.
